name: Alexander Zverev
intro: Alexander Zverev is a super-tall tennis star from Hamburg, Germany. His friends call him Sascha. He is the number 1 seed here, and he has a giant serve.
story: Sascha comes from a tennis family. His mom and dad were both pro players. His big brother Mischa was a pro too. His dad has coached him since he was a little boy. In 2026, Sascha finally won his first Grand Slam title at the French Open. He also has an Olympic gold medal from Tokyo.

funFacts.text: He is 6 feet 6 inches tall. That is taller than most doorways feel!
He travels with a little grey poodle named Lovik. Lovik has even had his own tournament pass.
He speaks three languages: German, Russian, and English.
He loves basketball. His favorite player ever is Dwyane Wade.
He met Roger Federer at age five and got his autograph. Years later he beat Federer in a real match!
He won the Olympic gold medal in Tokyo in 2021.
In his free time he plays golf and video games.

watchFor: Watch his serve: he tosses the ball way up high, then hits it so fast it is a blur.
